challenge.method: Tested a GPL-2.0-only reading and a substitution of the GStreamer library’s LGPL status for the application’s base license.
challenge.results: “At your option” expressly allows later GPL versions. The exception refers to “the GPL license Totem is covered by.” The library and plugins appear as participants in the permitted combination. Their licensing does not select the base for this Totem header.

limitations: This relationship concerns the supplied Totem 1.0.5 header pin. It establishes neither the license of GStreamer itself nor the licensing of all Totem files or plugins.
reasoning: Totem’s src/totem.h first grants redistribution or modification under GNU GPL version 2 or, at the recipient’s option, any later version. The same comment then adds the Totem project’s GStreamer plugin permission and dates its addition. Together those passages establish GPL-2.0-or-later as the documented base in this header.
